description:
Use this when the user wants the text for a post written: "write my captions", "caption this for TikTok and
Shorts", "give me a YouTube title and hashtags". Each caption is cut to the platform's limits: TikTok 2,200
characters, Instagram 2,200 and 5 hashtags, YouTube a 100-character title plus a description under 5,000 bytes,
Threads 500, X 280.
Not for: subtitles inside the video (edit_clip, translate_captions) or saving a post (draft_post). Saves
nothing: show the captions, then draft_post saves the chosen one. Free.

clip_id.description: Id of the clip, from list_clips.

platforms.description: Up to 5 of tiktok, youtube, instagram, facebook, threads, x, bluesky. Shorts, Reels and IG also work.

tone.description: Optional tone, e.g. funny, hype or calm. Empty means no preferred tone.
